Title: Realtime TTS-2 : Inworld Forums | Product Hunt
#1 ranked TTS, speech-to-speech, and LLM routing. # Realtime TTS-2 - Voice AI that feels as good as it sounds. Realtime TTS 1.5 is #1 on Artificial Analysis, voted best in blind tests by thousands of real users. TTS-2 builds on that with six major upgrades: natural language voice direction for tone, emotion, speed, and pitch. Text-based voice design, where you describe a voice in words and generate it. Try it free at inworld.ai/tts. It went on to become the #1 ranked voice AI on Artificial Analysis, voted best in blind listening tests by thousands of real users. That meant a lot to us, so we went back and rebuilt the model from the ground up. Today we're launching Realtime TTS 2.0. Try the live speech-to-speech experience at realtime.ai. Here's the thing we kept hearing from builders: voice AI was built for audiobooks and voiceovers. It sounds good, but it sounds like a human reading from a script. If you've ever talked to a voice agent and thought "something feels off," that's why. Realtime conversation is a completely different problem, and we decided to solve it. What can you build with it? * **Language tutors** that switch languages mid-session with the same voice, no re-recording. **Natural conversationality.** We trained the model on conversational speech instead of narration. Every voice you build on TTS 2.0 sounds like a person in conversation, not a narrator. **Full voice direction.** You steer the model with natural language the way you'd direct a voice actor. **Text-based voice design.** Describe a voice in plain text, generate it. TTS 2.0 takes that quality and adds everything that was missing to uplevel realtime conversation. I've been pumped about this launch for weeks and I'm so excited that we finally get share TTS-2 with you all. If you want to hear what it can do, jump into the playground at inworld.ai/tts and try voice design or steering for yourself or play with our realtime demo at realtime.ai. Because similarly to speech-to-speech models, Realtime TTS 2.0 was trained tobe *explicitly steered* to provide the most appropriate response, given the conversation context and agent's goal.

Inworld is an underrated gem for developers building scalable AI products. Their text-to-speech engine delivers quality that’s on par with ElevenLabs — but at a fraction of the cost (less than 5%). That alone makes it a game-changer for anyone shipping voice-driven experiences at scale. What really sets Inworld apart, though, is the full-stack approach: it’s not just TTS — their infrastructure and evaluation tools are built with growth and iteration in mind. This is AI designed for real-world applications that evolve alongside user needs. If you’re building a consumer-facing product and care about quality, iteration, and affordability — definitely give Inworld a serious look.
